name: donchian_channel_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY closes above its 5-minute Donchian channel high with a volume surge, systematic CTA and momentum algorithms that scan for N-period price extremes simultaneously trigger buy signals, creating a burst of institutional order flow over the next 30-90 seconds. Because NIFTY is index-aggregated (not a single stock), this breakout is not noise — it reflects broad market participation overcoming the supply zone established during the prior 5 minutes. The volume confirmation filters out wick-driven false breaks: a real breakout requires active demand, not a single large print. The VWAP alignment filter ensures the breakout is consistent with the session's dominant directional flow rather than a counter-trend spike.

indicators.name: donchian_high_60
indicators.purpose: 60 bars = 5 minutes — chosen as trade trigger, NOT 12x the original (30×12=360). We are catching the FIRST 15-90 seconds of a breakout burst, not a 30-minute trend. 5 minutes is the minimum meaningful consolidation at index resolution: less than 3 minutes generates too many false breaks from index tick noise; more than 10 minutes shifts this into a context filter rather than a trigger.

indicators.name: donchian_low_60
indicators.purpose: Symmetric 5-minute channel low for bearish breakdowns. Same rationale as donchian_high_60.

indicators.name: volume_sma_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling average volume as the denominator for the surge filter. 60 bars matches the channel lookback so both share the same reference window — a volume surge must co-occur with the breakout timeframe, not reference a much longer history.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Cumulative from session open — no lookback scaling needed. VWAP alignment filters out counter-trend breakouts: a close above Donchian high that is also above VWAP confirms institutional bias is bullish for the session.

conditions: close > donchian_high_60 (previous 60 bars, excludes current bar)
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions must hold on the same 5-second bar close

conditions: close < donchian_low_60 (previous 60 bars, excludes current bar)
buy_pe.confirmation: Symmetric: close breakdown with volume and below VWAP

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option points = ~6 NIFTY spot points at delta ~0.5. A valid 5-minute Donchian breakout on NIFTY should not retrace 6+ spot points within 90 seconds — a retrace that deep means the breakout was a false break and the supply zone held. This is tighter than the original ATR-based stop because we're holding 30x shorter and false breaks reverse immediately.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points = ~12 NIFTY spot points. A genuine 5-minute channel breakout on NIFTY typically extends 10-20 spot points in the first minute as momentum algorithms pile in (see Section 10.4: 1-min NIFTY move = 3-7 pts, we hold 1.5 min max). 6 pts captures roughly 50-70% of the expected first-leg move at 1:2 R:R.

filters.vix_filter: vix < 24 — above 24, NIFTY becomes gappy and breakout follow-through degrades; false breaks increase sharply
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST — skip opening 15 minutes of auction noise and last 10 minutes of position squaring
filters.volume_filter: volume > 1.3x 60-bar average — confirms real demand/supply, not a wick
filters.trend_filter: close > vwap for longs, close < vwap for shorts — session-level directional alignment
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit orders at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — Donchian breakouts are a well-known signal; crowding at exact 5-min channel highs could compress follow-through as more algos front-run the level

adaptation_notes: Original used 30-bar (30-min) Donchian on 1-min equity bars with ATR stop and trailing midline exit. Converted to 60-bar (5-min) Donchian on 5-second NIFTY index bars — deliberately SHORTER than 12x scaling (which would give 360 bars = 30 min) because our hold time is 15-90s not 30-180 min. Fixed option-point stops replace ATR% stops since delta ~0.5 maps cleanly from spot-point to option-point. Trailing midline exit removed — too complex for 15-90s holds and not needed when time_stop_bars handles duration. VIX and VWAP filters preserved from original as they remain valid on index.
weaknesses: Low win rate (~40%) — breakout strategies fail often; 5-minute channel on NIFTY will produce frequent false breaks during ranging sessions
5-second volume is noisy for NIFTY index — volume surges may be artifacts of large single prints, not broad participation
Donchian channel level at 5s resolution is well-known to automated systems; the exact level may have adverse selection as smarter algos fade the initial breakout

_source.original_stop: donchian_mid at time of entry (~50% of channel width)
